playpause.note: Icon is legible and fits the aesthetic, matching the electric blue glow.

prev.note: Fits well into the graphite button cluster.

repeat.note: Icon reads well and emits a good cyan glow.

vol.note: Great ribbed texture and blue illuminated ring. Rotates smoothly in the interaction frame.

seek.note: The slider nub moves smoothly, track features a pleasant blue fill.

shuffle.note: Toggle reads clearly, toggle state is visible.

visualizer.note: Glossy black glass looks correct; small dotted line reads as part of the interface.

album_art.note: Inset cleanly in a glossy dark recess. Fits nicely with visualizer styling.

notes: The overall piece perfectly matches the futuristic dark graphite and electric blue WMP aesthetic.
Interaction frame shows good logic on the slider and toggle states.
Good material reading on the brushed metal accents and glossy black screens.
improve: The blue glow on the seek slider fill in the interaction frame could be slightly brighter or closer to the electric blue of the main controls.
The empty space beneath the visualizer and album art is mostly plain graphite; adding a subtle bezel line or texture there might anchor the base.
